name: Trade Secret Protection
description:
This module provides an introduction to basic concepts of patent law, trade secret law and the law of licensing agreements. It consists of two lectures: "Patents and trade secrest" and "Licensing".
Topics covered are:
1) Patents and trade secrets
a) Patent law
- subject-matter under protection and prerequisites
- proceedings before the Patent Office
- legal effects of a patent
- the inventor's right to the patent
- assignment and licensing
- enforcing a patent
- termination of a patent
b) Trade secret law
2) Licensing:
- economic purposes
- license agreement: basic content
- pitfalls in licensing projects
- antitrust issues
prerequisites: German Business Law 1 and 2 (WI0000027, WI0000030) or corresponding knowledge.
